title: CoherentModuleFiniteTypeLocalRestrict
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a coherent X-module, and W an open of X. Then the restriction of F to W is of finite type.

source.place: Definitions 01BV (coherent), 01B5 (finite type), and Lemma 01B6 (pullback preserves finite type); verified at the official Stacks tag pages

proof.text: Restrict a finite-generating local presentation of F along the open immersion W. Open-immersion restriction preserves finite direct sums and epimorphisms, so the resulting presentation is finite locally.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_module_finite_type_local_restrict (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F → ∀ (W : X.Opens), ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj F).IsFiniteType
